thesis: The book Financial Statement Analysis for Value Investing by Stephen Penman and Peter Pope teaches value investors how to formally keep an accounting book on a firm to track its ability to generate growth and assess its risk. The authors argue that while understanding the business is primary, one must also understand how measurements flow into and do not flow into accounting, utilizing the balance sheet as a critical tool beyond just earnings or cash flows.
